_comment: Relevant IDs were fixed before any retrieval score was viewed. 'dev' questions calibrate top-k/threshold; 'heldout' questions were written afterwards and never used to tune. hit = any relevant id in top-k. For adversarial rows, every surfaced hit must be inside acceptable_ids (empty list = nothing may surface).
